picks.thesis: Remain 100% cash: the steep curve and low VIX do not compensate for unresolved event risk or unreliable market data.
picks.justification: The equity snapshot is timestamped on a Saturday, the research feed references earlier dates, and no second independent price source is provided, so freshness and reconciliation gates cannot pass. With no open positions, there is nothing to hold or sell; opening trades under unverifiable prices would violate the stale-data kill switch. Cash allocation is therefore 100% for this cycle.

picks.thesis: Cash is the trade: low-vol goldilocks is priced (VIX 14.5, SPY near highs) while 10Y 4.67% vs FF 3.63% and a +47bp curve already discount a soft landing; no instrument in this tape clears a declared, falsifiable edge after costs.
picks.justification: Book is flat, paper, effectively n=0 this run — cold-start sizing would be quarter-Kelly of an uncalibrated p, which is not a 10x mandate and is not attempted. Snapshot is single-source; headlines conflict with the Aug 29 as-of (NVDA earnings already in the -4.7% print); PYPL -12.7% and MRVL -10.5% are event gaps without an underwritten mechanism. Per-name risk cap is 50bps stop-to-entry and single-name ≤10% NAV; a race-to-$1m would breach both. Survive, measure, compound — in that order. Flat is a position.

picks.thesis: Disciplined barbell: defensive staples and high-FCF cash compounders balanced against select enterprise infrastructure and energy cash yields in a steepening yield curve regime.
picks.justification: Reviewed open positions against invalidation criteria: trimmed crypto cluster exposure by cutting MSTR (-7.3% drag and redundant to core BTC) and slightly reducing BTC to 7% NAV. Retained high-conviction core cash compounders (XLP, WMT, V, DE, ORCL, PLTR) while rotating capital into AMZN for underpriced cloud margin expansion and XLE for structural real-asset cash flow support.
